ops.title: deep-view wave SHIPPED 2026-07-21: cc-transcript 14.9.0 + capt-hook 12.8.0 + codex plugin 1.3.0; gates now see subagent + codex edits; isolate_modules orphan-attr bug was the real 'flake'
ops.body:
Three-repo wave closing the style-gate blind spot (gates never saw subagent/codex edits) —
**ALL SHIPPED 2026-07-21**. Plan: `~/.cc-pool/accounts/acct-04/plans/the-gate-s-logical-jellyfish.md`;
rollout log cc-notes `86fc8b1`.

- **P1 cc-transcript v14.9.0**: `Session.walk()`/`Session.deep` (DeepView/DeepSession, opt-in
  recursion, `attachments` seam) + **forward-only** `apply_patch→Edit` alias (a reverse
  `tool_alias_reverse` entry destroys ApplyPatchCall parse — never "complete" it). Recursion is
  OPT-IN by design (sweep-verified) — do not "upgrade" bare `tool_calls` to recurse.
- **P2 capt-hook v12.8.0**: `transcripts register` CLI + `capt-hook mcp` (FastMCP stdio, `[mcp]`
  extra) + plugin-root `.mcp.json` (repo convention BANS a `mcpServers` key in plugin.json —
  test_skills.py:153); registered transcripts fold into `evt.ctx.t.deep` at dispatch via
  `lazy_transcript(attach=)`; gap sites (style gate, EditedSource, has_read_glob/has_used_skill)
  ride the deep view. Review loop confirmed + fixed 6 findings across the surface (empty-string
  locators, relative-path anchoring, bounded-regular-file guard `readable_transcript`,
  256MiB cap).
- **P3 codex plugin v1.3.0** (cc-skills `v*` tag; plugin.json version must equal tag — the plugin
  is on 1.x now, old 0.2x notes are stale): codex-ask auto-registers every lane post-status-write;
  outcome in the lane `register` file; `$CAPT_HOOK_BIN` → `capt-hook` → `uvx` resolution;
  WaitDelay+Setpgid bound the invoke. Live e2e passed pre-release (real lane → `ok <tid>` →
  slot → `walk()` yields DeepSession(provider=codex)). codex-ask resolves AGENTS.md from the
  BINARY's plugin root (bin/../AGENTS.md) — e2e builds stage into plugins/codex/bin/.
- **The "flaky" resolution test was REAL, not contamination** (first conclusion wrong — proven by
  CI failing it in a clean run): conftest's `isolate_modules` purged first-imported submodules
  from sys.modules but left the PARENT package attr pinned to the orphan, so
  `from cc_transcript import codex` + monkeypatch patched a module the code under test never sees
  (its in-function `from cc_transcript.codex import ...` re-imports fresh). Fixed in the fixture:
  detach purged submodules from surviving parents when the attr is that module. Repro recipe:
  `pytest tests/test_daemon_server.py tests/test_transcripts_registration.py`. Lesson: a "clean"
  verification that excludes files is not CI-shaped — the excluded files were the polluter.
- Local sandbox: daemon-family tests (test_daemon_server/test_client/test_daemon_parity) +
  test_cli subprocess tests are load-flaky/environmental — never chase locally, CI gates.
  Overlapping pytest runs also genuinely prune each other's numbered basetemps (retention 3) —
  concurrent suites need explicit `--basetemp`.
- Usage-limit stalls: "agent stalled on all 6 attempts" = the account's 5h window exhausting;
  journal-cached results ratchet across resumes (`resumeFromRunId`); time big fan-outs to start
  just after a reset; rewrite a dead implementer's prompt into a recovery brief (COMMIT-FIRST).
- `codex:codex-wrapper` agentType is NOT in this session's registry despite plugin 1.1.0+
  shipping it — a Workflow `agentType:` that doesn't resolve fails the agent() call and
  `.filter(Boolean)` turns it into a silent empty review round; check the available-agents list
  before routing.
- Main checkout ~/Code/captain-hook was 33 behind at close (another session's fixture-DSL work
  in flight there); its `.venv` picks up the 12.8.0 pin at its next pull+sync.
